title: The Sales by Customer tile
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A workplace with sales to several distinct customers in the range, and a range with exactly one customer (seed invoiced work orders for several ZZAUTOTEST customers).
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the headline is the count of distinct customers with sales in the selected range, reading '{count} customer' for one and '{count} customers' otherwise.
2. Confirm the supporting line reads 'Top: {top customer name}'.
3. Confirm the tile has its own date-range control and a report link to the Sales By Customer report.
4. Confirm the sparkline shows the customer count over the selected range, bucketed like the KPI sparklines, so headline and sparkline describe the same window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Sales by Customer tile headline is the count of distinct customers with sales in the selected range.
  • The Sales by Customer headline reads "{count} customer" when the count is one and "{count} customers" otherwise.
  • The Sales by Customer tile's supporting line reads "Top: {top customer name}".
  • The Sales by Customer tile has its own date-range control.
  • The Sales by Customer sparkline shows the customer count over the tile's selected range, bucketed the same way as the KPI sparklines, each point the count of distinct customers with sales in that bucket, so headline and sparkline describe the same window.
  • The Sales by Customer tile shows a report link to the Sales By Customer report.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9577 (S5 — Count Tiles — Sales by Customer & At Risk); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S5; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R1: “The Sales by Customer tile headline is the count of distinct customers with sales in the selected range.”
  • S5-R2: “The Sales by Customer headline reads "{count} customer" when the count is one and "{count} customers" otherwise.”
  • S5-R3: “The Sales by Customer tile shows a supporting line reading "Top: {top customer name}".”
  • S5-R4: “The Sales by Customer tile has its own date-range control (Story 7).”
  • S5-R5: “The Sales by Customer sparkline shows the customer count over the tile's selected date range, bucketed by S4-R11, with each point the count of distinct customers with sales in that bucket. The headline and the sparkline therefore always describe the same window (S7-R4, S7-E1).”
  • S5-R6: “The Sales by Customer tile shows a report link to the Sales By Customer report.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
